english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for confidence as firm trust or certainty about a person, ability, or outcome.
Use 信心 as the all-purpose choice for trust in a person or thing, and for faith in an expected outcome rather than a formal creed.
Use this when assurance means inner confidence, trust, or freedom from doubt rather than an outward guarantee.
Use this when the context makes clear that the confidence is specifically in oneself rather than in a plan, person, or outcome.

examples.english: I have a lot of confidence that I will pass this exam.
examples.traditional: 我好有信心今次考試會合格。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 jau5 seon3 sam1 gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 wui5 hap6 gaak3
ngo5 deoi3 nei5 jau5 seon3 sam1

examples.english: I have complete assurance about this decision.
examples.traditional: 我對呢個決定好有信心。

examples.english: Although it was my first competition, I still had plenty of self-confidence.
examples.traditional: 雖然係第一次參加比賽，我對自己都有信心。
